scope: Independent read-only verification of actual ARM full-header layout object, bounded vendor Mali/OMX disassembly and actual OMX source-object evidence. No build rerun, ELF load, graphics ioctl or hardware execution.

Mali.fingerprint_context: Helper0x10224 stores incomingr0 infp, loads handle atfp+60 into r4, then validates this handle before private fieldreads. The buffer wrapper offset60 matches measured ANativeWindowBuffer.handle. Other accesses at32/36/48 match measured width/height/usage. Stripped local helper source names are not reconstructed.
Mali.size_derivation: native_header12 +4*(numFds1+numInts22); this does not prove every buffer allocation or memory lifetime.

selected_field_reads_match.context: Bit tests1/2/4 follow and match FRAMEBUFFER/UMP/ION enum values.
Framebuffer branch passes value as ioctl first argument.
Framebuffer branch offset read; full mapping semantics not proved.
Handle reloaded from buffer+60, then field read.
Separate helper loads buffer+60 handle and reads+12 in ION flag branch.

Mali.module_lookup: Public __egl_platform_initialize_android calls hw_get_module with gralloc string; string bytes checked at0x11c2e5.
Mali.callback_observation: Reads callback slots136/140 with lock/unlock-shaped arguments. This review does not elevate that observation to full callback ABI or runtime approval.

assessment: Concrete corroboration of the native-handle fingerprint and selected private-field offsets for the examined pinned source and blobs. No divergence found in this bounded set; this is not complete Mali/OMX ABI approval.
limits: No vendor ELF execution, EGL initialization, driver open, buffer allocation/import, ioctl, mapping, rendering or video decode was exercised.
Fingerprint and selected reads do not prove all fields, allocator semantics, ION/DMA-BUF/RGA, usage formats, ownership, lifetime, cache/coherency or fences.
Nearest-symbol+offset objdump labels do not identify stripped local helper source functions.
The private_handle_t probe uses compiler-supported layout with preserved warnings for offsetof on a derived non-standard-layout type; it is not a portable-language layout guarantee.
Shared-library dependencies and symbol versions must still be linked/loaded in a coherent Android system; no inference of RK3229 physical compatibility or boot.
